request: Move the feed to individually opted-in monthly journal records, keep published albums on user profiles, prioritize records in My, and simplify the point balance design.

behavior.feed: Moment publications only: one explicitly selected photo, saved caption and calendar date. A monthly album does not need to have been materialized yet.
behavior.profile: Single-photo public records first, with an independent published-album tab. The owner has a visible monthly journal entry and private account actions.
behavior.privacy: Records stay private unless the owner opts in. Other photos and monthly album documents are not included in a record publication. Existing records are not published by migration.
behavior.safety: Owner and record revision are checked server-side. Edits withdraw the old public copy; deletion tombstones every old copy. Publication revision CAS prevents delayed completion from undoing a private choice. Original images are re-encoded to bounded PNG with metadata removed.
behavior.retry: A saved record is reused after a failed publication. Same-photo re-publication preserves the current publication and its reactions. Every remote publication stage is bounded to 25 seconds.
behavior.points: Neutral single-line balance opens a charge/history sheet. Owner and route guards prevent stale account actions.

chromePublication.scope: Two actual record compose workflows plus 11 publication service cases, including decoded preview pixels, retry without duplicate save, no-op private withdrawal, owner ABA, late upload timeout, private finalize response and metadata-free ratio-preserving PNG.

verification.fixtureNote: Screenshots are actual production Flutter widgets with isolated fake accounts and bundled example photographs. Browser widget tests inject in-memory image bytes; native captures retain the real photographs. No test publication was added to production.

database.advisors: No new WARN/ERROR. Two new private RPC-only ledgers intentionally have RLS without direct policies and with all direct privileges revoked.

runtimeGuestChecks: Production feed renders the new monthly-record empty state.
